name: Area reaped
definition: Land area from which a crop was harvested in the period, as defined by the Ministry of Agriculture (AMID)

name: Area harvested
definition: FAOSTAT element Area harvested: area from which a crop is gathered, excluding area sown but not harvested

name: Yield
definition: Production per unit of harvested area

name: Farmgate price
definition: Price received by farmers at the farm gate, in Jamaican dollars (nominal, not inflation-adjusted)

name: Producer price (local currency)
definition: FAOSTAT producer price in local currency units (JMD for Jamaica)

name: Producer price (USD)
definition: FAOSTAT producer price in US dollars per tonne
